format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is ui-source tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs, run for the package by scripts/run-manifest-probes.mjs

body: <main style="display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 24px; padding: 24px">

<sf-admin-activity id="a" history-href="#/activity" runs='[{"id": "r1", "label": "Копия srv1.larena.cloud", "state": "running", "value": 42, "total": 100, "unit": "%", "href": "#/srv.backups"}, {"id": "r2", "label": "Обновление PHP на stage", "state": "running", "href": "#/srv.software"}]'></sf-admin-activity>

<script>window.__told = []; const wrap = () => { const sf = window.SF || (window.SF = {}); if (sf.__wrapped) return; sf.notify = (options) => { window.__told.push(options); }; sf.__wrapped = true; }; wrap(); customElements.whenDefined('sf-admin-activity').then(wrap);</script>

probes.title: two runs running: the trigger shows «Идёт 2», no failure mark, and its name says it in words

steps.script: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 80 && !(document.querySelector('#a .sf-admin-activity__trigger')); i += 1) await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, 100)); return Boolean(document.querySelector('#a .sf-admin-activity__trigger')); })()

probes.title: nothing running or failed: the element draws nothing

steps.script: (async () => { await customElements.whenDefined('sf-admin-activity'); await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, 300)); return true; })()

probes.title: a run fails while another runs: SF.notify error, a red mark beside «Идёт 1»; opening the list says open and the mark goes

steps.script: (document.querySelector('#a').runs = [{"id": "r1", "label": "Копия srv1.larena.cloud", "state": "running", "value": 42, "total": 100, "unit": "%", "href": "#/srv.backups"}, {"id": "r3", "label": "Перевыпуск сертификата simai.ru", "state": "failed", "text": "Центр сертификации не ответил.", "object": "simai.ru", "href": "#/srv.security"}], true)
steps.check: Boolean(document.querySelector('#a .sf-admin-activity__mark')) && document.querySelector('#a sf-badge[activity="running"]').getAttribute('text') === 'Идёт 1' && window.__told.some((told) => told.status === 'error' && told.title === 'Перевыпуск сертификата simai.ru: не удалось')

probes.title: the last running run ends: SF.notify success, and «Не удалось 1» stays in words

steps.script: (document.querySelector('#a').runs = [{"id": "r1", "label": "Копия srv1.larena.cloud", "state": "done", "value": 42, "total": 100, "unit": "%", "href": "#/srv.backups"}, {"id": "r3", "label": "Перевыпуск сертификата simai.ru", "state": "failed", "text": "Центр сертификации не ответил.", "object": "simai.ru", "href": "#/srv.security"}], true)
steps.check: window.__told.some((told) => told.status === 'success' && told.title === 'Копия srv1.larena.cloud: готово') && document.querySelector('#a sf-badge[activity="failed"]').getAttribute('text') === 'Не удалось 1' && !document.querySelector('#a sf-badge[activity="running"]')
